Whether exec should fail fast and not execute the script in further packages if the script fails in a individual package.

Whether exec should order the execution of the script in multiple packages based on the dependency graph of the packages. The script will be executed in leaf packages first and then in packages that depend on them and so on. This is useful for example, for a script that generates code in multiple packages, which depend on each other.
